char_dham.name: Yamunotri
char_dham.best_season: May to June, September to October
char_dham.access: Road to Janki Chatti, followed by an approximately 5 km mountain trail. Use only the current official advisory for local access conditions.
char_dham.image_alt: Yamunotri temple in its Himalayan valley

char_dham.name: Gangotri
char_dham.best_season: May to June, September to October
char_dham.access: The temple town is reached by road from Uttarkashi. Confirm road, weather and registration advisories before departure.

char_dham.name: Kedarnath
char_dham.best_season: May to June, September to October
char_dham.access: Road travel ends near Gaurikund. The final approach is a strenuous high-altitude trek; use registered services and the current official route advisory.

char_dham.name: Badrinath
char_dham.best_season: May to June, September to October
char_dham.access: Badrinath is road-accessible in the notified season. Check the official portal for registration, weather and route controls before travelling.

guidelines: Complete tourist and vehicle registration on the official portal before the journey.
Carry the registration letter or QR code and a valid identity document.
Check official weather, road and health advisories again on the day of travel.
Allow time for acclimatisation; the shrines are at high altitude and weather changes quickly.
Book helicopter travel only through the official IRCTC channel linked by the registration portal.
For yatra help call 1364 or 0135-3520100; use 112 for an immediate emergency.
